title: Surreal Fleur-de-Lis Dreamscape
description: A lone astronaut stands on a glowing path in the foreground while a silhouetted figure stands on a distant mountain peak. A massive ornate golden fleur-de-lis floats centrally between them, surrounded by a vibrant cosmic landscape of swirling nebulae, luminous orbs, and layered colorful mountains under a swirling psychedelic sky.
prompt: A surreal dreamlike landscape featuring a lone astronaut standing on a glowing path in the foreground and a distant silhouetted figure on a mountain peak. A giant ornate golden fleur-de-lis floats in the center of the composition. The environment is a vibrant cosmic scene with swirling colorful nebulae, luminous orbs, layered mountains in teal, orange and purple tones, and a psychedelic sky filled with glowing circles and ethereal clouds, in a painterly digital art style.
